answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the copper stake plus the attestation work, so the attacker's marginal cost rises linearly while honest participants earn yield. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock copper-backed tokens in an orchard vault before voting, and reputation grows only along a vine of verified peer attestations. Cheap identities never mature. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
